name: keyless hosted config, key path pointed at but NOT created
cmd: mkdir -p /root/.config/temur && printf '%s' '{"provider":"anthropic","max_tokens":4096,"base_url":"https://api.anthropic.com","model":"claude-sonnet-5"}' > /root/.config/temur/config.json && export APP_SECRET_FILE=/root/.config/temur/key && ls -l /root/.config/temur/key 2>&1; echo config-written

name: kernel user namespace support as the kernel reports it
doctor: the bash key sandbox line
cmd: export APP_SECRET_FILE=/root/.config/temur/key; temur doctor 2>&1 | grep -i 'key sandbox\|key isolation'
